name: Attribuly
summary: Recovers abandoned carts Klaviyo misses — identifies visitors, syncs intent signals back into Klaviyo and lets an AI agent send a personalised recovery email.
best_for: stores already running Klaviyo at volume, where a few percent more recovered carts is worth $450 a month and the identity-resolution layer has enough traffic to work with
skip_if: your monthly email revenue is below roughly $5,000 — the entry price eats the gain — or you do not run Klaviyo, since the product is built around it
honest_knock: This is the most expensive app in its category on the Shopify store by a wide margin, and the jump is not gradual — free to $450 a month with nothing in between. It is also an add-on rather than a replacement: the pitch is explicitly that it recovers carts “Klaviyo misses” and syncs identity signals back into Klaviyo, so you are paying for this on top of an email platform you already pay for. Work out what $450 a month needs to recover before it breaks even, and compare that against simply improving the flows you already have.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-13 on apps.shopify.com/attribuly; every amount unchanged since 2026-08-18) A free plan that covers the first $1,000 of recovered email revenue, then Capture at $450 a month and Recapture at $500, both with a 14-day free trial. All charges in USD, billed every 30 days. Note the shape: the free tier is metered on recovered revenue rather than on time, so it ends when the tool starts working. The listing's rating moved from 4.8 out of 154 reviews (18 August 2026) to 4.7 out of 166 reviews (13 September 2026), with 76% five-star and 7% one-star.
